screens.title: Pause veil
screens.description: A sparse pause surface keeps the scene visible and gives Resume a clear, explicit action.

screens.title: Chapter path
screens.description: A quiet checkpoint path marks current, completed, and unknown chapters, with a separate commit to start.

screens.title: Contextual hint
screens.description: A transient action prompt can be inspected, dismissed, and restored without implying a permanent HUD.

expectedText: Pause veil lifted for this local example; no game session is running.
Local checkpoint now begins at Lowlands. Progress exists only until reload.
Prompt restored at the edge of the field.
